A Family-Owned and Operated Company

About Valley Septic & Plumbing

Rooted in the Fraser Valley, we’ve been keeping your homes running smoothly for generations. Our team brings unparalleled knowledge and a personal touch to every job, treating your plumbing and septic needs as if they were our own.

A Journey of Service and Community

Our Story: Rooted in Family

Valley Septic & Plumbing’s story is one of family, dedication, and deep community roots. Our journey began with a single van and a vision to provide reliable plumbing services to our Fraser Valley neighbors.

From those humble beginnings, we’ve grown alongside our community. We expanded from basic plumbing to comprehensive septic services, meeting the evolving needs of our rural areas. As word spread of our reliable work and fair pricing, our family of skilled professionals grew, as did our fleet of fully-equipped vans.

Throughout our evolution, one thing has remained constant: our commitment to treating every customer like family. Whether it’s a leaky faucet or a complex septic system, each job is an opportunity to build lasting relationships.

Today, we proudly serve the entire Fraser Valley with the same values that got us started – integrity, hard work, and a deep love for our community. As we look to the future, we’re excited to continue growing with and serving the place we call home.

Contact Us

More Than Just Pipes and Tanks

Our Mission

At Valley Septic & Plumbing, our mission goes beyond fixing leaks and maintaining septic systems. We’re dedicated to enhancing the health, safety, and comfort of our Fraser Valley neighbors through expert plumbing and septic services.

Our commitment is threefold:

To Our Community

We strive to build lasting relationships, treating each customer as a valued neighbor.

To Quality

We pledge to deliver exceptional service, using the latest techniques and technologies to ensure lasting solutions.

To Education and Prevention

We’re committed to empowering our customers with knowledge, helping them understand and maintain their plumbing and septic systems for long-term reliability and peace of mind.

Our Core Values

More Than Just Pipes and Tanks

At Valley Septic & Plumbing, our values form the foundation of everything we do. They guide our work, shape our interactions, and define our commitment to you. These values aren’t just words – they’re our promise to you.

Professionalism

Our team consists of exceptionally trained plumbing experts. We bring knowledge, skill, and a courteous attitude to every job, ensuring top-quality service every time.

Efficiency

We arrive in fully-equipped vans, ready to tackle any plumbing or septic challenge. This preparation minimizes follow-up appointments, saving you time and hassle.

Reliability

Serving the Fraser Valley with Pride
